$comment: The 67-product printed catalogue, as CMS product rows.
SOURCE: https://wear-run.help/catalogue -> Google Drive file 1l4ZbvZDMU-7yVWMhTGtdcjMRY5ixGqc-,
a 68-page PDF. Page 1 is the index; pages 2-68 are one product spread each.
`sourcePage` on every row is the PDF page it came from, so any value here can be
checked against the artwork rather than trusted.
PRODUCT CODES ARE NOT THE CATALOGUE'S. The printed codes are unusable: 67 products
share only 26 of them, and R-XPB alone is printed on 26 different garments. Codes
here are generated as R- plus the initial of each significant word, lengthened on
collision. Verified: 67 codes, zero collisions. `slug` is the code lowercased.
R-XPS IS THE ONE EXCEPTION. It already exists in the CMS as product id 1 with the
code RXPS and the slug `rxps`. The slug is printed on physical QR tags and must
NEVER change; only its code and description are updated. See the import script.
NO COLOURWAYS, DELIBERATELY. Each spread shows 5, but the printed colour labels are
multi-word per colourway ('GREY GREEN WHITE BLACK' is one Glitch-Core colourway) and
a colour slug goes on a printed QR tag. apps/cms/src/fields/colourways.ts records why:
the CLO file tells you the colours, and ImportColoursFromFile reads the real names and
hex swatches out of it. Guessing 335 tag URLs here would be unrecoverable.
Descriptions are rewritten from each spread's own paragraph: sentence case, and the
PDF text layer's dropped `ti` ligature repaired by hand against the page ('Athle c',
'Mo on', 'func onality'). Facts are the catalogue's; the shouting is not.

products.shortDescription: Men’s performance cycling bib shorts, built for long days on road, gravel and MTB. Pro compression spandex carries a multi-density chamois pad and breathable mesh bib straps, and the whole garment takes a full sublimation print. Silicone leg grippers, flatlock stitching and an ergonomic panel design keep everything where it should be over endurance mileage.

Women’s performance cycling skinsuit in a four-way stretch nylon knit. Pro compression spandex, a multi-density chamois pad and breathable mesh bib straps sit under a full digital print. Silicone leg grippers, flatlock stitching and ergonomic panelling hold an aero race position comfortably over long distances.

A tennis dress drawn from the Great Pyramid of Egypt. The digital sublimation across the bra echoes the texture of the moon, the skirt takes the pyramid’s conical shape, and the compression belt is textured after the stone blocks themselves. Built in interlock spandex with cotton and neoprene detailing for court movement.

A performance tennis dress built directly from the geometry of the old mine cut diamond. It is constructed from 22 cut fabric panels, each mapped to echo a single facet, so the angular panelling creates a sense of movement and refraction across the body as the player moves.

A tennis bra and skirt set designed for court and training performance, taking its structure from the natural geometry of bee hives. The materials are chosen for flexibility and a relaxed bond between skin and garment, so the player can attempt more flexible and more outstanding shots.

A well-engineered piece of athletic wear built to meet the demands of tennis performance while keeping a stylish look. Every seam and panel is thoughtfully placed, supporting athletic movement and a flattering silhouette at the same time. It blends high-tech function with contemporary design for competitive play and active lifestyles alike.

A tennis dress inspired by the tiger tail butterfly, a species known for both its beauty and its flexibility. Built in a recycled interlock knit with digital sublimation across the body, it carries that reference into a garment made for movement on court.

This tennis dress draws on the fierce form of a scorpion, with sharp, armoured contours that echo the creature’s powerful stance. Its bold angular patterns create a striking, predatory look, while a performance-focused construction keeps agility, comfort and confidence intact on court.

A tennis and pickleball court shirt built around the giant oceanic manta ray. The upper pattern is designed after the fish floating in open ocean, and the sleeves stand in for the eye area. Made in a single jersey recycled polyester with screen printing.

A highly stylised, fitted women’s American football jersey defined by its contoured, female-specific cut. The body carries an aggressive distressed brushstroke graphic, and the design incorporates a V-neck with contrasting ribbed trim. Built in a double interlock poly-stretch with both digital sublimation and silicone printing.

The men’s counterpart to the Aggressor jersey, defined by a contoured, masculine-specific cut and the same aggressive distressed brushstroke graphic across the body. A V-neck with contrasting ribbed trim completes it. Built in a double mesh interlock with silicone printing and EVA foam padding.

A soccer tee built from six panels in total: two matching side panels, a front and a back panel, and two matching arm gussets with sleeves. Cylindrical piping in the same fabric runs along the sleeves to move air around the neck, a V-shaped collar is attached, and folded hems finish the sleeve and waist.

A premium stretch poly-cotton performance trouser in a slim athletic tapered fit, with bold geometric panel graphics and a custom “Never Look Back” leg print. A secure elastic waistband with drawstring and comfortable ribbed ankle cuffs keep the trouser in place through intense soccer training.

A soccer jersey that stands out for a sleek pattern, a sharp white chevron and contrast white sleeves. Lightweight quick-dry polyester and breathable moisture-wicking fabric keep airflow up, and an ergonomic athletic fit allows unrestricted movement through intense matches and training.

Designed for high-level training sessions, scrimmages and drills, where teams need quick, temporary differentiation between players for tactical reasons. The aero liner mesh keeps players from overheating, and adjustable sides give a more tailored and secure fit than a traditional loose-fitting bib.

A soccer jersey with a distinctive tonal, abstract geometric pattern across the body and sleeves, creating a subtle but dynamic visual texture. It carries a classic fold-over polo collar and a simple V-neck opening, pairing a traditional silhouette with contemporary construction. Diagonal solid-coloured panels across the chest and shoulders mark out functional zones within the athletic cut.

A soccer jersey with a tonal abstract geometric pattern across the main body, creating a subtle but dynamic hexagon sublimated texture. A clean V-neck opening reinforces the traditional silhouette while contemporary construction delivers a modern athletic fit. Diagonal solid-coloured panels across the chest and shoulders add bold visual accents and mark out functional zones.

A soccer jersey carrying a tonal abstract geometric sublimation across the main body for a dynamic visual texture. A clean V-neck opening keeps the traditional silhouette while contemporary construction delivers a modern athletic fit. Diagonal solid-coloured panels across the chest and shoulders define functional zones and leave room for sponsor placement.

A soccer jersey with a tonal abstract geometric sublimation across the main body, creating a lightweight visual texture without added bulk. A clean V-neck keeps a traditional silhouette while supporting mobility, and modern construction delivers an optimised athletic fit. Diagonal solid-colour panels across the chest and shoulders define functional zones and add high-contrast structure.

A soccer jersey with a tonal abstract geometric sublimation across the main body, creating a lightweight neon texture without added bulk. A clean V-neck keeps a traditional silhouette while supporting mobility, and modern construction delivers an optimised athletic fit. Diagonal solid-colour panels across the chest and shoulders define functional zones and add high-contrast structure.

A versatile soccer jersey in a high-performance breathable fabric with advanced moisture-wicking, carrying a full sublimation print with a bold glitch design. Lightweight quick-dry construction and strategically placed ventilation panels raise airflow, while soft stretch material and flatlock stitching reduce chafing over a full match.

products.garmentFit: Athletic fit with ergonomic panel design
products.shortDescription: A men’s training top in performance stretch fabric, with a full-length front zipper for easy on-off and ventilation. Moisture-wicking quick-dry material and breathable construction keep it comfortable all day, and flatlock stitching reduces chafing. Lightweight but durable, it suits gym work, running, warm-ups and general active wear.

A men’s hybrid training vest in a lightweight performance fabric with breathable mesh panels and quick-dry, moisture-wicking material. The sleeveless athletic design uses ergonomic panel construction and a full sublimation print, with flatlock stitching for chafe-free comfort. Built as a multi-sport vest for gym, running, CrossFit, cycling and outdoor training.

A scuba suit combining high-stretch laminated neoprene with a tonal geometric design for a streamlined, low-bulk profile. The ergonomic neckline supports unrestricted movement, while anatomically engineered panels improve fit, hydrodynamics and thermal efficiency. Reinforced chest and shoulder zones raise abrasion resistance, and flatlock and bonded seams give long-lasting durability underwater.

Made from closed-cell neoprene laminated with high-stretch nylon, with a tonal geometric pattern for a sleek, low-bulk finish. The ergonomic neckline allows full range of motion while maintaining a water seal, and anatomically mapped panels optimise fit, hydrodynamics and thermal retention. Reinforced chest and shoulder panels add abrasion resistance, while flatlock and bonded seams reduce chafing over repeated dives.

A scuba suit with a tonal geometric design across the main body, giving a sleek, modern look without added bulk. An ergonomic neckline supports natural movement, while advanced panel construction ensures an optimised, anatomical fit. Solid-colour panels at the chest and shoulders reinforce key zones, adding durability and visual structure for performance-focused diving.

A scuba suit with a tonal geometric surface treatment on the main body, engineered to keep a low-profile finish without adding bulk. An ergonomically shaped neckline supports unrestricted range of motion and sealing efficiency, while anatomically mapped panel construction optimises fit, flexibility and hydrodynamic performance. High-density solid-colour panels at the chest and shoulders reinforce high-wear zones for long-term durability in demanding dive conditions.

A women’s sports bra that fuses high-impact support with an energetic, artistic look. Premium moisture-wicking power knit offers breathable flexibility, keeping you cool while the dynamic print carries the momentum. Equally at home in a HIIT session or styled for a day out.

A sports bra combining high-performance fabrics with a signature hexagonal flex-zone construction for adaptability and security. Whether the session is HIIT intervals or a yoga flow, it delivers breathability and flexibility without giving up support. Built in a poly stretch tricot that carries from the gym into casual wear.

Engineered with high-support compression and breathable, moisture-wicking spacer knit, this bra minimises bounce while maximising comfort. The sleek strappy design holds through HIIT sessions and yoga flows alike, giving support without restriction.

A women’s bra zip-up vest combining the security of a high-performance sports bra with the coverage of a crop vest. Breathable, flexible eco-power mesh keeps you cool through a workout or a day out, and a reversible zip adds a second way to wear it.

A women’s workout cropped full-sleeve top combining a fashion-forward cropped cut with high-performance function. The premium ultra-soft single jersey offers breathable coverage that contours to the body, making it a natural layering piece for studio sessions or the walk home afterwards. Thumb holes keep the sleeves in place through a full session.

Engineered for high-output training, the cropped cut provides ventilation to keep you cool as the workout heats up. A compression interlock in a moisture-wicking athletic spandex delivers a lightweight, flexible feel that moves with the body rather than against it. Built for everything from lifting heavy to yoga flows.

A women’s cropped quarter-sleeve top offering a strategic advantage: shoulder coverage that protects against barbell friction, paired with a ventilated cropped cut that keeps the core cool. High-performance sweat-wicking cotton stretch manages moisture instantly, so it stays dry through the most intense intervals.

A men’s full-sleeve half pullover designed to move from the squat rack to the city street. A sleek athletic cut highlights the physique without restricting it, and the eco-poly stretch waffle knit gives both drape and a premium hand-feel. The versatile collar stands sharp for a polished look or unzips for something more relaxed.

A men’s full-sleeve training jersey built for someone who moves straight from the gym to the street. A sleek athletic cut highlights the physique without restricting it, and the power knit and waffle knit panels give the piece its drape and premium hand-feel. Made to be the hardest-working layer in the wardrobe.
performanceFeatures: Power knit and waffle knit panels

products.shortDescription: A premium comfort sweatshirt in a soft, durable flex jersey with a smooth, breathable feel for all-day wear. The relaxed but refined fit allows unrestricted movement, making it equally suited to training warm-ups, travel and everyday use. A clean crew neckline and precision-finished cuffs and hem hold their shape, and the rich indigo-toned fabric is fade-resistant.

A running shirt built for versatility, with advanced moisture-wicking and a quarter-zip design for instant airflow regulation, so it adapts to body heat as intensity rises. Lightweight, high-stretch mesh and piqué knit fabric allows unrestricted movement, making it as suitable for intense training as for casual wear.
performanceFeatures: Mesh knit and piqué knit panels

products.shortDescription: Women’s performance running shorts combining high-velocity breathability with a precision fit. Advanced moisture-wicking eco-poly stretch actively pulls sweat away from the body, keeping you cool and dry through intense intervals or marathon training. A built-in liner adds support and a streamlined cut prevents bunching.

A men’s trouser in a modern tapered silhouette, built in a micro poly stretch that delivers breathability and unrestricted flexibility. Precision-stretch fabric supports every stride, making it as suitable for high-intensity training as for urban street wear. Zip pockets and a zip hem finish it.

A men’s training pant combining high-performance durability with a sleek, modern look. Breathable mesh knit and kinetic jersey panels actively regulate temperature, while the precision-tapered fit removes distraction whether the day is leg day or a walk across the city. Zip pockets and a fashion mesh panel finish it.
performanceFeatures: Mesh knit and kinetic jersey panels

products.shortDescription: Women’s yoga tights built on a compression architecture that gives targeted muscle support to reduce fatigue during prolonged holds, with a high-rise ergonomic waistband for zero-distraction coverage. Hydrophobic fibre technology creates a moisture-transport system that expels sweat rather than absorbing it, and the puri knit fabric retains its shape and opacity through hot yoga or high-impact conditioning.

Women’s yoga tights fusing high-performance utility with modern aesthetics. Squat-proof opacity gives total confidence during deep stretches, while the sleek contouring silhouette carries from the yoga mat to the city street. Reinforced with sustainable colour-lock dyeing, the poly stretch knit resists fading and pilling, so they look as strong on day 100 as on day one.

A women’s yoga belt bottom with an engineered waistband designed to provide core support and a stay-put fit, so there is nothing to adjust mid-flow. A high-quality breathable poly cotton stretch jersey gives a second-skin feel that handles intense hot yoga sessions and casual outings with equal ease.

The heavyweight terry knit version of the Core Align tight, built on the same compression architecture for targeted muscle support during prolonged holds. A high-rise ergonomic waistband gives zero-distraction coverage, and hydrophobic fibre technology expels sweat rather than absorbing it. At 220-300 GSM in 100% recycled polyester, it holds shape and opacity through the hardest conditioning.

A heavyweight structured cotton jersey tee in a boxy drop-shoulder silhouette, carrying vertical statement typography. A reinforced crew neck collar, side-seam panelling and double-needle hemming give it durability, while pre-shrunk fabric holds the fit. A statement essential for brand loyalists, urban lifestyle and casual layering.

An ultra-heavyweight tee with architectural vertical seaming and high-density X-Milo branding. Relaxed drop-shoulder construction, a ribbed mock neck and a structured boxy drape give it presence, finished with a soft-touch enzyme wash and a side-split hem. A premium statement piece for lifestyle collections and brand campaigns.

A men’s performance half-zip polo in a premium tech-piqué power knit, with a modern blade collar and a semi-auto lock zipper placket. Split-hem construction and reinforced shoulder seams sit alongside odour-resistant moisture wicking and four-way stretch mobility. Ready for custom sublimation or embroidery, it works for golf, team travel and the casual office alike.

A polo where timeless sophistication meets modern endurance. Meticulously crafted from a pure cotton jacquard knit, it offers superior breathability and flexibility, making it a natural choice for anything from business smart-casual to weekend leisure.

A men’s trail and road full-sleeve jersey in a high-tenacity wicking interlock with snag-resistant construction. Raglan sleeves give freedom of movement, an extended drop tail adds coverage, and optimised airflow panels keep temperature down. Unlimited colour sublimation with premium fade-proof ink makes it as suitable for mountain biking and downhill as for cool-weather riding.

A men’s half-zip midlayer with a brushed thermal fleece interior and a stand-up mock neck. A premium half-zip gives ventilation control, and ribbed cuffs and hem hold the shape. Moisture-wicking warmth and durable double-stitch construction make it an essential warm-up pullover for team training, sideline recovery and travel.

A women’s crop hoodie in soft-touch tech fleece with structured raglan panelling and a modern cropped silhouette. Wide bell sleeves and an oversized hood give it shape, and a ribbed hemline finishes it. Breathable warmth and high-density logo printing make it a premium lifestyle layer for the yoga studio, recovery and urban streetwear.

A men’s hoodie in a premium mid-weight terry knit tech fleece with a soft-brushed interior and minimalist centred branding. A spacious kangaroo pocket, wide ribbed cuffs and hem and crossover hood construction give it everyday utility. Pill-resistant fabric, moisture-wicking comfort and twin-needle stitching make it a durable pullover for daily commutes, team loungewear and casual layering.

A women’s tracksuit in a soft-touch thermal terry fleece, pairing a retro quarter-zip polo collar with a relaxed wide-leg pant. A tonal oversized logo graphic, comfort elastic waistband and deep side pockets give it everyday use, while premium drape and stretch with ribbed cuff details keep it a luxury athleisure set for travel, recovery and loungewear.

A men’s tech tracksuit with a full-zip jacket and stand collar over a tapered pant. Contrast side panelling, zippered hand pockets, an elasticated waist with drawcord and ankle zips make it practical to move in and out of. Quick-dry moisture management and wrinkle-resistant fabric make it a complete training set for team travel, warm-ups and athletic lifestyle.

A women’s co-ord in a heavyweight waffle-knit cotton blend, pairing a structured quarter-zip polo collar and boxy cropped silhouette with wide-leg flow trousers. Tonal high-density branding, an elasticated high-rise waist and premium ribbed trim give it a tailored lounge fit with textured thermal warmth. Built for remote work, casual travel and elevated off-duty style.

An ultralight wind-resistant nylon taffeta shell with a ventilated back yoke and breathable mesh lining, taking a full sublimation print. Elasticated cuffs and a drop-tail hem hold the streamlined aero fit, and a DWR finish adds water repellency. Reinforced articulated seams and an ergonomic sleeve design make it packable all-weather protection for road cycling, gravel and outdoor endurance training.

A men’s sherpa jacket in a high-loft thermal fleece with bonded mesh lining and durable ripstop overlays. A secure zippered chest pocket, elasticated cuffs and hem and a relaxed athletic fit make it easy to live in, while double-needle reinforced stitching and an articulated sleeve design hold up outdoors. Superior heat retention for outdoor adventure, urban commuting and après-ski layering.

A men’s tech jacket in a weather-resistant bonded softshell with geometric utility chest panels and a high-neck scuba hood. Water-repellent reverse-coil zippers, adjustable velcro cuffs and a thermal regulation lining make it genuinely all-season, and reinforced bar-tack stitching holds the stress points. Built for urban commuting, athletic training and outdoor lifestyle.

A men’s tech jacket in a high-density bonded softshell with an adjustable scuba hood system and a weather-resistant DWR finish. Tactical chest zippers, dual-layer storm cuffs and a thermal regulation lining handle changing conditions, and reinforced bar-tack stitching with 3D engineered panelling holds the shape. Multi-functional performance outerwear for urban training, warm-ups and outdoor exploration.

A women’s thermal jacket built on an engineered matrix-ripstop shell with a high-loft eco-synthetic fill. An insulated storm hood with toggles, a weather-resistant DWR finish and elasticised bound cuffs seal out the weather, while a heat-retention lining and reinforced quilted baffles hold warmth in. Articulated sleeve panels keep movement free in extreme conditions.

A men’s longline jacket in a weather-resistant bonded softshell with a high-neck scuba hood and toggles. Dual-entry utility pockets and adjustable storm cuffs sit under a matte memory-shine finish, and the extended commuter cut adds coverage. Thermal regulating fabric, reinforced bar-tack stitching and articulated sleeve construction make it versatile for urban exploration and cold-weather training.

A men’s urban tech coat in a premium membrane-lined bonded softshell with a brushed thermal interior and a high-neck storm hood. A water-resistant DWR finish, secure utility zip pockets and adjustable toggle cuffs handle the weather, while a moisture-managing membrane and reinforced bar-tack stitching hold performance. Engineered 3D panel construction makes it all-weather outerwear for city, travel and street.

products.fabricComposition: Shell: 100% Polyester Taslon / Lining: 100% Polyester Taffeta
products.shortDescription: A men’s commuter suit in a weather-resistant ripstop softshell with a thermal-regulating tech fleece lining and a high-neck scuba hood. Utility zipper pockets, reinforced knee panels and adjustable toggle hem and cuffs make it practical, while moisture-wicking fibres, a windproof membrane and taped waterproof seams keep the weather out. Heavy-duty hardware throughout for city commuting, travel and outdoor lifestyle.

A men’s utility jacket in 1.2 mm cowhide leather with a thermal-regulating inner lining and a multi-point adjustable storm hood. Secure waterproof utility zippers and adjustable velcro cuffs seal it up, while hydrophobic moisture management and reinforced double-needle stitching hold performance. 3D articulated shoulder panels give a durable all-season outer shield for urban commuting, outdoor training and transitional weather.

A riding jacket with removable CE-Level 2 armour at the shoulders, elbows and back, a zip-out thermal liner and a mesh air-flow ventilation system. A distressed vintage finish, YKK brass zippers and adjustable waist tabs give it the look, while pre-curved articulated sleeves and accordion stretch panels keep mobility. Triple-reinforced safety stitching and a hydrophobic weather-resistant coating make it an all-season street, cruiser and cafe racer jacket.

A men’s technical jacket in an advanced hydro-repellent softshell with a structural scuba hood and integrated visor. A breathable core ventilation system, matte finish waterproof zippers and adjustable velcro cuffs with a shock-cord hem give full control over the weather. A moisture-wicking thermal lining, reinforced bonded seams and 3D articulated sleeves make it high-performance outerwear for training, urban commuting and element protection.
